notes.title: Slap 'em UP! Demo Now Live on Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618990/09848f96f274033c3104588ff9e8a2d8f426d408.png"][/img]
Hey everyone! We're excited to announce that our game is part of Steam Next Fest – yay! ✨ Come check out our brand-new demo build packed with improvements and exciting new features![/p][p][b]
What's New in This Demo?
[/b] Here’s a quick look at the latest patch:[/p][p][b]
New Features[/b][/p][p]- Added Rematch button at the end of a Private Room game – play again in the same room without needing to create a new one![/p][p]- Added Rulebook in the Options and Tutorial screens.[/p][p]- Added Re-Sync system to reduce display issues caused by screen minimizing or app switching during gameplay on smartphones.[/p][p]- Added Next button on the User Agreement page so players no longer need to scroll all the way down manually.

[/p][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p]- Fixed a bug that caused the game to freeze after card exchange.[/p][p]- Fixed a bug that prevented players from playing a card if they were holding it when a turn ended.[/p][p]- Fixed a visual bug with the turn indicator arrow displaying incorrectly.[/p][p]- Fixed a visual bug where the turn timer displayed different times for players in the same room.[/p][p]- Fixed UI display issues where certain elements appeared on the wrong screens.[/p][p]
